name: telegram-notify
description: Lets Claude send Telegram notifications to you: one fixed chat, send-only, no polling.
long_description: A send-only MCP server with two tools. notify sends a message to one chat fixed in this extension's settings; no tool takes a recipient, so Claude cannot message anyone else. notify_file sends a file, only from one folder you choose. It never calls getUpdates, so the same bot can keep serving another tool that polls it.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Send a message to your Telegram chat

tools.name: notify_file
tools.description: Send a file from the allowed folder to your Telegram chat

bot_token.title: Bot token
bot_token.description: From @BotFather in Telegram (/newbot). An existing bot works, even one another tool polls.

chat_id.title: Chat id
chat_id.description: Your numeric Telegram id (ask @userinfobot). Press Start in your bot's chat first. Every message goes here and nowhere else.

files_dir.title: Folder for files (optional)
files_dir.description: The only folder notify_file may send from. Leave empty to turn file sending off.
